$comment: Shared activity-ledger fixture (#181), consumed by BOTH ports: android ActivityLedgerTest and ios MorseKitCheck. Data, not code — see CLAUDE.md's two-ports rule. Expected values are derived from the rules in `derivation`, not captured from either implementation. Regenerate only with a deliberate change to the thresholds or the cap, and say so in the commit.

derivation.day: the LOCAL calendar day the session ended on, written yyyy-MM-dd — the same day boundary PracticeStreak uses
derivation.seconds: sum of the whole seconds of every session recorded on that day; a session that logged no duration adds 0 but still records the day
derivation.level: the pure function of a seconds total: 0 for 0 s, 1 for 1-299 s, 2 for 300-899 s, 3 for 900-1799 s, 4 for 1800 s and up (`levelThresholds` are the seconds at which levels 1-4 begin)
derivation.dayLevel: a day's tile shade: level(seconds) for a recorded day, but never below 1 — a recorded day with 0 s is still a practice day; a day with no record is level 0
derivation.cap: at most `capDays` distinct days are kept; recording a day beyond the cap drops the earliest day(s) until the count is back at the cap
derivation.note: Derived from these rules directly, independently of either implementation.
